# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_option (Data Source)

Custom Kea DHCPv4 options (**Services ▸ Kea DHCP ▸ Kea DHCPv4 ▸ Options**), attached to subnets and reservations through their `options` attribute.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the Kea DHCPv4 option.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) DHCPv4 option code, e.g. `42`; the GUI lists the known codes with their names.
- `data` (String) Payload to send to a client.
- `description` (String) You must enter a description here. It is used to reference this option inside reservations and subnets.
- `encoding` (String) Choose the encoding type. "Hex" supports all encapsulated and structured options generically via payload in hexadecimal byte pairs. One of `hex`, `ipv4-address`, `ipv6-address`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, `int32`, `boolean`, `string`, `fqdn`.
- `force` (Boolean) Always send the option, also when the client does not ask for it in the parameter request list.
- `match_code` (String) Only send the option to clients that sent this option code. Empty to send it to every client.
- `match_data` (String) Data to match against the selected DHCP option.
- `match_encoding` (String) Encoding used to evaluate the match condition. "Hex" supports all encapsulated and structured options generically via payload in hexadecimal byte pairs. One of `hex`, `ipv4-address`, `ipv6-address`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, `int32`, `boolean`, `string`, `fqdn`.
